item.title: House votes to effectively end the impeachment effort against Pete Hegseth
item.description: The House voted 211 to 204 to refer the articles of impeachment against Hegseth to committee, ending the push by Rep. Thomas Massie.

item.title: Poll: Seven in 10 Americans want new Congress to end Iran war
item.description: A Reuters/Ipsos poll finds most Americans want Democrats in Congress to end the Iran war.
